summary: The plugin supports Python 3.14 only. Every hook now runs through a small launcher that checks the Python version before anything else: below 3.14 the plugin stops only its own work, with one message that names the Python it found, the fix (macOS: `brew install python3`) and a session restart, and it never blocks the host session, other prompts or any tool call that is not the plugin's own work. CI tests one Python per operating system.
